ko: [Title] MAIN_LOG_105_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=1)]우르수스 장군의 어깨띠! 한번 메봐도 될까? 내 말은…… 으, 그러니까…… 메봐도 되겠습니까?
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]물론이지. 우르수스를 떠나면 그냥 빨간 어깨띠일 뿐.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]그나저나, 요즘 젊은이들 사이에서 '장군'이란 단어는 칭찬으로 쓰이지 않는다던데?
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]그저 마지막에 군대가 상황을 평정하지 못한 바람에, 다들 실망했을 뿐이죠……
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]솔직히, 다들 군대를 그렇게 믿지는 않았어요.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]그래도 뭐, 저는 지어준 별명이 마음에 들어요.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]……나도 내가 진짜 장군과는 거리가 멀다는 건 알아요. 그러니까 지금은 무시해도 됩니다.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]하지만, 저는 자치단 모두를 지켜내고 앞을 가로막는 모든 적을 쓰러뜨릴 거예요. 거짓말이 아닙니다.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]그렇게 그 칭호가 좋다면 그 어깨띠를 가져가도 되네.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]아쉽게도 전쟁 때문에 끊어진 바람에 아무런 가치도 없지만 말이야. 더 좋은 선물을 해야 할 것 같다만.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]그럼…… 그럼 책은 어떤가요. 이스티나 말로는 책을 쓰고 계신다던데, 저는 그 책을 보고 싶어요.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]내가 쓴 책을? 과거에 관한 책에 무슨 읽을 게 있겠나.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]그래도 미래에 관한 책이 좋지 않을까 싶군. 내가 찾아봐 주지.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]사탕 하나 먹겠나? 내가 좀 챙겨왔는데.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]……아니요, 저는 사탕 싫어해요.
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]……저도.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]달콤한 것에 죄책감을 가질 필요는 없네. 자네들은 아직 아이잖나.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]우르수스의 겨울은 매우 길고 춥지. 하지만, 우리는 눈 녹는 날을 위해 그 고된 겨울을 참고 견디는 게 아닌가?
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_105_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=1)]Lemme look at your Ursus Army ribbon... Um, if that's okay with you? Please?
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]Of course. Although being so far removed from Ursus now, it's no more than a plain red ribbon.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]I gather that 'General' wasn't meant as a compliment, among the youth.
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]It was just, the Army never came to take control of the situation, even in the city's final hours. That's what disappointed everyone so badly.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]But to be honest, it's not like we really trusted the Army before that either.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]I mean, screw them, though. I like the nickname.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]Yeah yeah... I know I'm a far cry from a real general. Laugh at me all you want.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]But I'm gonna protect everyone in the U.S.S.G, and I'll topple anything that gets in our way. I swear.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]If you're that fond of the title, then by all means, take the ribbon.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]But it has no worth at all, now that battle has torn it in two. Perhaps you deserve a better gift.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]Th-The book, then. Istina said you were writing a book. We'd all love to read it.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]My book? I doubt you'd a find a book about the past to be worth reading.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]I might have other books, that write of things to come. Let me take a look.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]In the meantime, would you like some candy? I carry some with me.
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]...No thanks, I don't like sweets.
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]Me neither.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]Haha, no need to be ashamed of liking sweet things. You're still children, after all.
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]Winter in Ursus is a long one, and fiercely cold, but we endure it. All so we may see the days of melting snow.
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_105_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=1)]おい、ウルサスの将軍のサッシュ、アタシにも見せろ……じゃない、見せてくれ……ください？
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]喜んで。だがすでにウルサスを去っているのでな、今はただの赤いリボンにすぎん。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]若者の間では「将軍」は褒め言葉ではないと聞いているが。
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]最後のあの時、いつまで経っても軍は街に騒ぎを鎮めに来なかったから、みんな失望してるんだ……
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]だがそれ以前から正直、誰も軍をそんなに信用してなかったけどな。
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]だけど、そんなことはどうだっていいさ。アタシはあいつらが付けてくれたあだ名を気に入ってる。
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]……自分と本物の将軍にすげー差があるのはわかってる。別に今アタシを見下そうと構わねぇ。
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]だけど、アタシは自治団のみんなを守る。目の前のすべての障害をぶっ壊す。これは嘘じゃねぇ。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]君がそこまでこの称号が好きというなら、このサッシュを持って行ってもいい。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]だが、これは戦争中に二つに断ち切られており、何の価値もない。もっといいものをプレゼントしてやるべきかもしれん。
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]じゃあ──じゃあ本をくれ。オマエは本を書いていると、イースチナが言っていた。みんな見たがってんだ。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]私が書いた本？　過去に関する本だ、読む価値などない。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]未来について書いてある本が他にあるかもしれん、探しておくとしよう。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]キャンディでもなめるか？　たくさん種類があるぞ。
[Dialog(head="char_115_headbr", delay=0.5)]……いらねぇ。キャンディは嫌いだ。
[Dialog(head="char_405_absin", delay=0.5)]……私も。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=1)]甘さに罪悪感を感じる必要はない、君たちはまだ子供なのだから。
[Dialog(head="char_188_helage", delay=0.5)]ウルサスの冬は長く、そして寒い。しかし我々は雪が解けるその日のために冬を耐え抜くのだ。
